steps: Deploy byte-verified current module and separate fixed wrapper on authorized isolated producer; controlled fixture only.
Run exactly8 initial and32 measured serial requests with independent wire assertions.
Export/join native rows by sample+version+nativeRequestId; preserve all rows and overages.
Prepare signed fixture Date before its first test, then4 controlled AD/RRSIG cases.
Restore both original modules/settings and verify2 public checks plus independent module hashes.

operations.change: Only /signed uses a controlled future Date to prevent second-boundary HTTP age from invalidating unrelated TTL/signature assertions. Default composed endpoints unchanged; change made after CPU campaign, before any signed request.

decision.closureBasis: Complete current-source representative sample with correct DNS, unique native metrics, most CPU <=10ms and no platform termination; current safety/cache/DNSSEC evidence plus unchanged-library regression provenance and documented workload limits. Actual current-source expired/hostname-mismatch/self-signed HTTPS rejection is separately proven by explicit526 controls plus production SERVFAIL.

limitations: One finite representative workload and colo; no exact cold/warm isolate identity or reliable p95/p99 guarantee.
First initial sample65ms and all9 overages among40 payloads remain; warmup is reported separately, not discarded.
Six of32 measured CPU values exceed10ms; 81.25% is an observation, not a new universal acceptance threshold.
Public-source ECH remains functional but historical uncached costs are high; no per-request uncached handshake Free guarantee.
Current TCP one-off failure and older resource failures/missing telemetry are retained in dated reports, not relabeled.
Existing independent interop and library regressions are reused with exact library/test tree, lock and runtime input equality; no fresh full npm/Rust success claimed.
Controlled RRSIG records test mutation/finalization semantics, not DNSSEC cryptographic authenticity.
The isolated producer was restored to historical original modules, not left serving the candidate.
